scientific_integrity: All finite results computed with exact integers and a standalone reproducible program. The checker is separate from independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive finite claim for n <= 3 pairs; one checked four-pair reversal; no general-n theorem or claims for incomplete preferences, ties, and variable utility scales. Scientific novelty assessed against inspected sources but unindexed overlap remains possible; no independent scientific audit.
title: Nash stable matchings refine egalitarian optima through three pairs, with a sharp four-pair reversal
